newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Mirabell IPO seen 150 times subscribed - sources.
newsitem.headline: Mirabell IPO seen 150 times subscribed - sources.

text.p: The initial public offering (IPO) of shares in shoes distributor Mirabell International Holdings Ltd is expected to be about 150 times subscribed, market sources said at close of its subscription on Thursday.
An official announcement of the subscription result will be made on December 3 and dealing in the company shares will begin on December 6.
Mirabell offered 60 million new shares at HK$1.22 per share, representing weighted average and fully diluted prospective price to earnings multiples of 6.1 and 7.1 times respectively.
The company said the net proceeds of HK$63 million will be used to set up new outlets in Hong Kong, and to fund purchase of premises, centralise warehouses and administrative offices.
Proceeds will also be used to repay bank borrowing and for general working capital, it added.
Mirabell currently has more than 40 outlets in Hong Kong and Macau to distribute footwares including famous brands such as Timberland, Dr. Martens, Marlboro Classic, Florsheim and Rockport.
